snippet.title: Interactive Drama | Road to Empress Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#盛世天下 #RoadtoEmpress The debut trailer for Road to Empress has just dropped, and it's making a stunning impact!

This isn't just any game—it's an innovative interactive drama where you're the protagonist, not just an audience member! Step into the shoes of China's only empress, forge your own destiny, and master the intricate world of palace intrigue. With over 100 creative ways to die, how long can you survive?

✅App Store：https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6741892043
✅Google Play：https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.n1studio.sstx
✅Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478050
✅We'd love for you to fill out our survey: https://forms.gle/oJop5MUH8x1SKjuPA
